churches.name: St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
churches.desc: Large Catholic parish in the Jebel Ali Worship Village with multilingual Masses.
churches.hours: Church open daily until about 9:30 PM. English Masses: Mon-Fri 6:15 AM, 9:00 AM, 7:00 PM | Sat 8:30 AM, 5:30 PM, 7:00 PM | Sun 7:30 AM, 9:00 AM, 10:30 AM, 5:30 PM, 7:00 PM
churches.tip: Masses in other languages (Malayalam, Tagalog, Tamil, Arabic and more) change by week. Call +971 4 884 5251.

churches.name: United Christian Church of Dubai (UCCD)
churches.tip: English-language services; confirm times with the church.

churches.name: Gurunanak Darbar Gurudwara
churches.desc: Dubai's largest gurudwara. Free vegetarian langar for everyone, served daily.
churches.hours: Timings were revised: recently 6:00 AM-6:00 PM (last entry 5:30 PM). Some sites still list 4:30 AM-9:00 PM
churches.tip: Cover your head (scarves at the entrance) and remove shoes. Tel +971 4 882 7550; latest timings at gurudwaradubai.com.

churches.name: Hindu Temple Dubai (Jebel Ali)
churches.desc: Multi-deity temple beside the gurudwara, opened in 2022. Free entry.
churches.hours: Daily, about 6:00-6:30 AM to 8:30 PM | Evening aarti 7:30 PM
churches.tip: Weekends and festivals may need a free QR booking at hindutempledubai.com.

churches.name: Christ Church Jebel Ali (Anglican)
churches.desc: Anglican/Episcopal congregation with Friday and Sunday worship; times vary by service.
churches.tip: Friday and Sunday services; confirm times with the church.

churches.name: Worship Village overview
churches.desc: The complex hosts about nine places of worship: churches, a gurudwara and a Hindu temple, all within walking distance.

malls.name: Ibn Battuta Mall
malls.desc: Themed shopping mall linked to the metro by a covered walkway.
malls.transit: Ibn Battuta Metro (covered link to the mall)
malls.hours: Sun-Thu 10 AM-10 PM | Fri-Sat 10 AM-midnight (Ramadan and holidays differ)
malls.tip: Taxis wait at the China, Persia and Andalusia court entrances.

malls.name: Ibn Battuta: China Court
malls.desc: Entrance court with the replica Chinese junk; Asian dining.

malls.name: Ibn Battuta: Tunisia Court
malls.desc: Tunisian-themed court; Carrefour is reported near here.

malls.name: Festival Plaza

malls.hours: Listed open until midnight; IKEA, Lulu and ACE set their own hours

malls.name: The Pavilion

transport.name: Red Line: Life Pharmacy branch
transport.desc: Jabal Ali (R38) - Ibn Battuta (R39) - Energy (R40) - Danube (R41) - Life Pharmacy (R42, formerly UAE Exchange).
transport.transit: Check the destination on the train and platform display

transport.name: Red Line: Expo 2020 branch
transport.desc: Jabal Ali (R38) - The Gardens (R70) - Discovery Gardens (R71) - Al Furjan (R72) - Jumeirah Golf Estates (R73) - DIP (R74) - Expo 2020 (R76).
transport.transit: Check the destination on the train and platform display

transport.name: Changing between branches
transport.desc: Riding from the north, board whichever train shows your branch's destination. Going between the two southern branches (for example Discovery Gardens to Ibn Battuta) means changing at Jabal Ali.

transport.name: F43
transport.desc: Ibn Battuta Metro to Discovery Gardens.

transport.name: F44
transport.desc: Energy Metro to Jebel Ali Village, Festival Plaza and Jebel Ali Gardens, with a stop at the Worship Village.

transport.name: F46
transport.desc: Ibn Battuta Metro to Green Community and Dubai Investments Park 1 and 2.

transport.name: F49
transport.desc: Danube Metro to Jebel Ali Industrial Area 1 and nearby labour accommodation.

transport.name: E101
transport.desc: Ibn Battuta to Abu Dhabi Central Bus Station. Reported fare AED 25 by Nol card; check the RTA app for the current fare and times.
transport.hours: Reported fare AED 25 by Nol card

transport.name: DPR1
transport.desc: Ibn Battuta Metro to Dubai Parks and Resorts via The Gardens Junction.

transport.name: DP World Jebel Ali Port
transport.desc: Dubai's flagship container port, opened in 1979 and described as the world's largest man-made port. Visitors cannot simply drive in.
transport.transit: Danube Metro, then bus or taxi
transport.tip: Gate 4 is the closest gate to JAFZA. Trucks leaving the port use the Gate 3 inspection complex.

transport.name: Gate passes for the port and JAFZA (Tasreeh)
transport.area: Jebel Ali Port and Free Zone
transport.desc: PCFC's 24-hour online system for visitor, one-day, temporary and permanent passes. Passes are tied to a specific port and gate.
transport.tip: Apply at tasreeh.ae before you travel. A gate pass is needed whatever your visa type.

transport.name: Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC)
transport.desc: Dubai's second airport, next to Jebel Ali. The metro does not reach it; buses and taxis connect it to the Red Line.
transport.transit: Ibn Battuta Metro + Bus N55, or Expo 2020 Metro + Bus F55
transport.tip: The airport's own site lists both buses about every 30 minutes. Taxi from Ibn Battuta Metro is the alternative.

transport.name: Bus N55: DWC and Ibn Battuta
transport.area: Ibn Battuta to Al Maktoum Airport
transport.desc: RTA bus linking Al Maktoum International Airport with Ibn Battuta bus and metro stations.
transport.tip: Check the RTA app for the current timetable and fare.

transport.name: Bus F55: DWC and Expo 2020
transport.area: Expo 2020 Metro to Al Maktoum Airport
transport.desc: RTA bus between Expo 2020 Metro Station and Al Maktoum International Airport. It no longer runs to Ibn Battuta.
transport.tip: Use N55 from Ibn Battuta instead.

transport.name: Dubai International Airport (DXB) by metro
transport.desc: The Red Line serves Terminal 1 and Terminal 3 stations. Terminal 2 has no metro station.
transport.transit: Take any northbound Red Line train toward Centrepoint
transport.tip: Allow about an hour from Jebel Ali; check the RTA app for exact times.

transport.name: Jabal Ali Metro Park & Ride
transport.desc: Free multi-storey parking for metro riders at the Red Line junction. Tap a Silver or Gold Nol card at the entrance, ride the metro with the same card, then tap again to leave.
transport.tip: Free only if you ride the metro. Stays longer than 24 hours can be fined.

transport.name: Ibn Battuta Mall parking
transport.desc: Large covered and surface parking for the mall, beside the metro and bus stations.
transport.tip: Parking guides list it as free at all times.

dubai_streets.desc: Port/JAFZA toward Expo, Al Qudra and Hatta.

dubai_streets.name: Al Yalayis Street
dubai_streets.desc: Links E11 to E311 and E611.

dubai_streets.name: Garn Al Sabkha / Al Hadaeq St
dubai_streets.desc: Jebel Ali Village / Discovery Gardens to E311.

dubai_streets.name: JAFZA South corridor
dubai_streets.desc: Al Maktoum Airport Road / JAFZA South corridor: links JAFZA South and E11 across E311 to Dubai South, Logistics City and DWC airport.

dubai_streets.name: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St
dubai_streets.desc: Coastal road to Marina, JBR, Palm.

dubai_streets.name: Hessa Street
dubai_streets.desc: Coast to Al Barsha / Arabian Ranches.

dubai_streets.name: Al Maktoum / Airport Road
dubai_streets.desc: Al Maktoum Road / Airport Road: Deira Corniche across Al Maktoum Bridge (Salik gate) past DXB terminals to Al Khawaneej.

dubai_streets.name: Al Mina / Al Wasl Road
dubai_streets.desc: Al Wasl Road / Al Mina Road: coastal route parallel to E11 from Umm Suqeim through Satwa and Port Rashid to Deira. No Salik.

dubai_streets.name: Roundabouts 1-13
dubai_streets.desc: Local roundabouts around JAFZA and Jebel Ali; numbering follows local signage.

stations.Ibn Battuta (R39): Ibn Battuta Mall (6 courts), Carrefour, Fitness First. Buses F43, F46, E101, DPR1, F44.
stations.Energy (R40): Start of F44 to Jebel Ali Gardens, Festival Plaza and the Worship Village (churches, gurudwara, Hindu temple).
stations.Danube (R41): Buses F49 (Jebel Ali Industrial) and F54 (JAFZA South).
stations.Life Pharmacy (R42): Terminus of the Life Pharmacy branch (formerly UAE Exchange).
stations.Jabal Ali (R38): Branch junction. Change here between the two southern branches.
stations.The Gardens (R70): The Gardens community; DPR1 passes The Gardens Junction.
stations.Discovery Gardens (R71): Discovery Gardens clusters; F43 and F45 buses.
stations.Al Furjan (R72): Al Furjan community and The Pavilion; F45 to Discovery Gardens.
stations.DIP (R74): Dubai Investments Park; F46 serves DIP 1 and 2.
stations.Expo 2020 (R76): Expo City Dubai: Al Wasl Plaza, car-free loops, Garden in the Sky.

car_repair.tip: Check the RTA app for the exact address and booking.
